item.title: UW-W to Host Women’s Basketball NCAA Regional
item.description: The University of Wisconsin-Whitewater will host a NCAA women’s basketball regional for the sixth consecutive championship this weekend. The Warhawks are set to host the four-team regional with games scheduled for Friday and Saturday. UW-Whitewater (19-8) will take on Transylvania (24-4) at 7:15 PM Friday evening in Kachel Gym. item.title: UW-W Men’s Basketball NCAA Regional: First game in St. Louis
item.description: For the first time since 1997, all of the WIAC men’s basketball teams are competing in the NCAA Regional Championship. UW-La Crosse won the automatic bid by beating UW-W in the championship game; the others were selected at-large.
